_source: 01-botbhai/PLAN.md §2 'Salon price ladder' (tools/test_sales_kit.py fails if they differ)

tiers.name: Founding
tiers.note: First 3 salons; price fixed for 12 months
tiers.gives: Standard features. In return: a baseline from your register, a testimonial, and use of anonymised numbers

tiers.name: Lite
tiers.gives: WhatsApp bot (prices, FAQ, booking, reschedule/cancel), 24 h + 2 h reminders, owner alerts, dashboard + Excel

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.gives: Lite plus review asks, opt-in win-back/offers, bridal enquiry flow, 9:30 AM daily list, SEO mini-site, web voice, monthly ROI report

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.gives: Standard plus Meta ads management (you pay ad spend) and a phone voice receptionist (300 min included, then ₹3/min)

whatsapp_fees.paid_by: the salon, directly to Meta on its own WhatsApp account
